values.name: Clank
values.description: Sentient mechanical beings built from a variety of materials, including metal, wood, and stone.

values.name: Drakona
values.description: Wingless dragon-humanoids with elemental breath and natural scaled armor.

values.name: Dwarf
values.description: Short, sturdy folk with dense musculature and skin well suited to tattoos and gemstone embedding.

values.name: Elf
values.description: Tall, pointed-eared humanoids with heightened senses who enter a celestial trance instead of sleeping.

values.name: Faerie
values.description: Winged, insectile creatures who undergo a metamorphosis during their lifetime.

values.name: Faun
values.description: Goat-like humanoids with horns, cloven hooves, and long limbs.

values.name: Firbolg
values.description: Bovine humanoids with broad noses, long tails, and remarkable strength.

values.name: Fungril
values.description: Mushroom-like beings of extreme variety in appearance, communicating through mycelial networks.

values.name: Galapa
values.description: Turtle-like humanoids with retractable shells for protection.

values.name: Giant
values.description: Towering humanoids with broad frames and, in early life, additional eyes.

values.name: Goblin
values.description: Small folk with large ears and keen senses suited to navigating in darkness.

values.name: Halfling
values.description: Small humanoids with oversized feet and ears, naturally attuned to magnetic fields.

values.name: Human
values.description: Adaptable, dexterous beings known for their endurance.

values.name: Infernis
values.description: Demon-descended humanoids with horns, canine teeth, and colorful skin.

values.name: Katari
values.description: Feline humanoids with retractable claws, slit pupils, and heightened senses.

values.name: Orc
values.description: Square-featured folk with decorative tusks and pointed ears.

values.name: Ribbet
values.description: Amphibious frog-humanoids with webbed appendages and a hopping gait.

values.name: Simiah
values.description: Ape-like beings with prehensile feet and tails, skilled at climbing.

values.name: Highborne
values.description: Accustomed to a life of elegance, opulence, and prestige within the upper echelons of society.

values.name: Loreborne
values.description: A society that favors strong academic or political prowess and values knowledge.

values.name: Orderborne
values.description: Communities focused on discipline or faith, unified around shared principles.

values.name: Ridgeborne
values.description: Mountain dwellers known for hardiness and adaptation to harsh alpine terrain.

values.name: Seaborne
values.description: Water-based societies closely tied to the ocean tides and the creatures who inhabit them.

values.name: Slyborne
values.description: Communities operating outside the law, with disparate goals and clever means of achieving them.

values.name: Underborne
values.description: Subterranean societies recognized for incredible boldness and skill in engineering.

values.name: Wanderborne
values.description: Nomadic peoples defined by their traveling lifestyle rather than any one location.

values.name: Wildborne
values.description: Forest communities defined by their dedication to the conservation of their homelands.

values.name: Arcana
values.description: Innate and instinctual magic, channeling raw elemental forces.

values.name: Blade
values.description: Weapon mastery, achieving power over death through skilled combat.

values.name: Bone
values.description: Tactics and the body, controlling physical abilities and predicting opponents.

values.name: Codex
values.description: Intensive magical study, commanding versatile magic through recorded knowledge.

values.name: Grace
values.description: Charisma, bending perception and defining reality through magnetism.

values.name: Midnight
values.description: Shadows and secrecy, controlling enigmas and obscurity.

values.name: Sage
values.description: The natural world, unleashing raw earth and creature magic.

values.name: Splendor
values.description: Life, granting healing and control over death.

values.name: Valor
values.description: Protection, channeling strength to defend allies in battle.

values.name: Bard
values.description: A charismatic performer and storyteller who channels Grace and Codex to inspire allies.
values.classItem: A romance novel or a letter never opened
values.hopeFeature: Make a Scene — Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

values.name: Druid
values.description: A shapeshifting guardian of the wild, drawing on Arcana and Sage magic.
values.classItem: A small bag of rocks and bones or a strange pendant found in the dirt
values.hopeFeature: Druid's Hope — Spend 3 Hope to transform into a Beastform without marking Stress and raise one trait by +1 until dropping the form.

values.name: Guardian
values.description: An unshakable protector who channels Blade and Valor to hold the line.
values.classItem: A totem from your mentor or a secret key
values.hopeFeature: Frontline Tank — Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

values.name: Ranger
values.description: A keen-eyed hunter and tracker who draws on Bone and Sage.
values.classItem: A trophy from your first kill or a seemingly broken compass
values.hopeFeature: Hold Them Off — Spend 3 Hope when you succeed on an attack with a weapon to use that same roll against two additional adversaries within range of the attack.

values.name: Rogue
values.description: A cunning infiltrator who channels Grace and Midnight.
values.classItem: A set of forgery tools or a grappling hook
values.hopeFeature: Rogue's Dodge — Spend 3 Hope to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you, or until your next rest.

values.name: Seraph
values.description: A divine agent of judgment and protection, channeling Splendor and Valor.
values.classItem: A bundle of offerings or a sigil of your god
values.hopeFeature: Life Support — Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

values.name: Sorcerer
values.description: A wielder of innate, volatile magic drawn from Arcana and Midnight.
values.classItem: A whispering orb or a family heirloom
values.hopeFeature: Volatile Magic — Spend 3 Hope to reroll any number of your damage dice on an attack that deals magic damage.

values.name: Warrior
values.description: A dedicated combatant who channels Blade and Bone mastery.
values.classItem: The drawing of a lover or a sharpening stone
values.hopeFeature: No Mercy — Spend 3 Hope to gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls until your next rest.

values.name: Wizard
values.description: A scholar of magic who channels Codex and Splendor through intensive study.
values.classItem: A book you're trying to translate or a tiny, harmless elemental pet
values.hopeFeature: Not This Time — Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.
